messages:
Maya P.: Quick design ping — I pushed a new iteration of the Create API Key modal to Figma. Need fast eyes on copy, keyboard flow, and the warning state for 'Full access'.

Raj C.: Linking the file: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/create-key-modal — thanks! main asks: 1) does the danger language read heavy? 2) can we make default scope safer?

Olivia N.: Skimming now. First impression: tone is fine but 'Full access' feels scary without context. Suggest adding one-liner under the option: "Includes read/write to all org resources." Small type. Also move the ephemeral toggle above the submit button so it's a visible decision.

Sam O.: Dev note — moving the toggle changes form layout a bit. If ephemeral is above submit, we need to ensure the keyboard tab order hits it before CTA. I'll update tabindex.

Jules (a11y): A few a11y nits: 1) The danger warning uses orange/black — contrast fails for small text. Need WCAG AA contrast. 2) Screen reader: the full-access checkbox needs aria-describedby pointing to the expanded explanation. 3) Modal close button should be focusable and have aria-label="Close create key modal".

Maya P.: Copy proposal (short):
- Full access label: "Full access — all org resources"
- Help text: "Includes read and write permissions across your organization. Use only when necessary."
- CTA: "Create key" / secondary: "Cancel"

Raj C.: I like short copy. Could we add a soft confirmation step when selecting Full access? e.g., a single-line inline confirmation: "Selecting Full access will require an additional confirmation." or a lightweight confirm toast?

Olivia N.: Inline confirmation: show a small inline checkbox: `Confirm full access` with a short reason placeholder. That avoids modal-clustering but forces deliberate action.

Sam O.: Implementation idea: use a two-step enable for the `Full access` toggle — state=off -> user clicks -> reveals inline checkbox + reason text input + keyboard focus lands on checkbox. Only if checkbox checked does the `Create key` CTA become enabled. Works with form validation and keeps request flow predictable.

Jules (a11y): For the inline pattern ensure the reason input has label and aria-required when visible. Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver — inline reveal must move focus to the new content or announce it.

DesignBot: Accessibility checklist: contrast, aria-describedby on policy text, focus order, keyboard-only create flow, live region for success message. Marked as checklist item #1848123456-CK.

Maya P.: Quick UX question about empty state for keys list after revoke: should we show an action card "Create a key" with keyboard-focusable primary? Current figma shows a CTA but no keyboard affordance note.

Olivia N.: Yes, show primary CTA as a real button (not link) and ensure it's first in tab order. Add brief explainer: "You can create scoped or ephemeral keys for limited use."

Raj C.: Cool. Action items: Sam to prototype keyboard flow + tabindex; Jules to run quick SR tests; Olivia to add inline confirm component to figma and adjust color tokens; Maya to update copy and small help texts. I'll sync up after 24h. :thumbsup:

Sam O.: On it — I'll drop a WIP branch and post screenshots.

Jules (a11y): I'll run a quick NVDA pass tomorrow and post notes.

Olivia N.: Updated figma link with inline confirm component: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/create-key-modal?node-id=52:0

Maya P.: Thanks team — this was fast. If anyone spots urgent phrasing that might be blocked by legal, ping me and I'll loop them in.

Raj C.: Leaving this open for 48h for reviews.

DesignBot: Thread archived in 48h unless new replies."
